summary: F1/F2/F3/F4/F6 resolved; F5/F7/F8 remain, with new F9. Tightened F1 probe confirms actual SET ROLE denial. Original probes pass; expanded probes report 12 passed, 10 failed. Project checks pass. Records updated; no commits.

findings.explanation: A crash during submission rolls back the attempt marker, causing recovery to resend without polling. A crash between terminal poll recovery and callback application can strand an exhausted draft permanently.

Reconciliation accepts missing correlation IDs and can complete workflows from uncorrelated responses. Transport still accepts non-object JSON, allowing downstream attribute errors to abort processing.
Invalid effective dates and timestamps still register supply points. Required signature validation and the core consumer ownership boundary remain unimplemented.
Both applications share the runtime shadow credential, which can connect to and read the other client's account tables. Live read-only probes confirm access in both directions.

verification_gaps: Crash probes simulate transaction boundaries; no live process-kill campaign performed.
Broker bootstrap was model-tested; no fresh-volume deployment performed.
Image-digest comparison, billing-under-market-outage, browser and hosted CI verification were not performed.
